nom: Naked Sundays SPF50 Golden Glow Shimmer Sunscreen Mist

segments.oily: The one reviewer who names oily skin says the mist works well as long as she uses less and pats it in rather than spraying heavily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her skin dry and dull, say the mist gives a hydration boost and works well for very dry skin.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who names combination skin, a beauty expert, lists it as her new favorite sunscreen without describing any specific issue.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one who also describes her skin as dry, report no irritation and no breakouts from the mist.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, describe the mist as cooling and hydrating; one reviewer notes her skin briefly felt dry and tight right after spraying, though the feeling passed once the mist settled.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no burning, stinging, or redness, including a couple who got the mist directly on their eyelids or eyes by accident without irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or sensitive report the mist doesn't cause breakouts or clog pores.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer who names oily skin says the mist works for her but recommends using less product and patting it in rather than spraying it on heavily.

aspects.libelle: Fine, lightweight mist that dries fast
Soft, natural shimmer rather than chunky glitter
Shimmer can be barely noticeable to some
Layers over makeup without disturbing it
Sweet fruity scent instead of a chemical smell
Felt pricey for a small bottle to some

extraits.texte: I like this shimmer mist because it protects my skin from the sun and I can see small specks of glitter over my makeup even though it's very hard to notice. This mist is very lightweight which unfortunately makes it harder to spot the specks of glitter over your makeup even if you spray a very generous amount on. I found that using the shimmer mist over my arms made the glitter stand out stronger and brighter which I enjoyed better. With the glitter, the spray itself gives off a strong smell of sunscreen after spraying it on but it goes away after a couple of minutes. In addition to spraying the mist over my makeup, I found that it made my skin feel dry and tight which concerned me for a bit but fortunately enough the feeling went away as the mist settled on my skin. Overall, this shimmer mist is a cute topper for your makeup that not only adds glam to your face but protects your skin from the sun! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm a beauty guru who loves trying out all of the latest beauty products from hair, skincare, and makeup! I was so dang excited to get my hands on the Naked Sundays golden glow shimmer mist! I really loved this product, it sprays evenly and is very lightweight. It gives you this incredibly beautiful shimmery glow! I have acne prone skin, I love that this didn't break me out! I also really appreciate the fact it has spf in it. The size seems kinda small but that's okay. One thing I'm not a big fan of is the smell it has. Was a little hard for me to bare with at first. It truly leaves the skin feeling hydrated and looking kissed! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was really excited to try this spray, and it's honestly such a clever way to handle reapplying sunscreen over makeup without smudging my foundation. The mist is incredibly fine and light, the glitter is really just a slight, subtle sheen that gives a nice little glow rather than looking like chunky sparkles. It feels super cooling and hydrating the second you spray it—the watermelon and hyaluronic acid make it such a refreshing pick-me-up on a hot afternoon. It definitely delivers on that radiant, luminous look if that's what you're after. Just use less and pat in if you tend to have oily skin like me. The scent is mild and actually pleasant, so you don't have to deal with that typical harsh chemical sunscreen smell. Since it's a mist, I just use it as a quick, convenient way to top up my SPF over my makeup throughout the day, and it's been a really handy addition to my routine. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've really been loving the Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Mist and have been using it every time I go out. It gives such a pretty glow that looks amazing when the light hits my skin. It never looks glittery or too sparkly, it's just a radiant finish that makes skin look dewy. I especially love using it on my shoulders, décolleté, and arms so that I can get a natural, sun-kissed look. My skin can be a little dry and dull so this mist gives it a boost and makes it look much more hydrated. I've also been using it as a highlighter on my face. I like to spray a bit on my hands and then dab it on my cheeks because it adds a gorgeous, high-shine "wet look" so my face appears healthier.The formula is very lightweight and feels refreshing to mist on my skin. It's not sticky or greasy, which makes it easy to reapply as needed throughout the day. The fragrance gives me summer vibes because it has a hint of watermelon, but it's not overpowering. In addition to the shimmer effect, the mist has nourishing ingredients that leave my skin feeling soft and smooth. This is a huge bonus for me since I get the glow combined with the hyrdation benefits.This mist has become a staple in my routine because it's simple to use and always makes me look luminous. If you want something that gives a glass-skin effect for both your body and face, I highly recommend trying this mist! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: My Skin Smells Good And Has A Golden Glow
extraits.texte: My name is Michele and I am a Beauty Expert in my 30's with combination, fair skin. The Naked Sundays Golden Glow Shimmer Glitter Mist Setting Spray Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Sunscreen is my new favorite sunscreen. This amazing Sunscreen Spray smells so good I can't get enough. It has a sweet, fruity Watermelon and Patented PENTAVITIN Kakadu Plum scent. It's the perfect scent for Spring and Summer. I love its shiny golden and silver spray bottle and its purple spray applicator. This 2.53 fluid ounce bottle is the perfect size for travel as it can fit in a purse, tote or travel bag . I love how easy it is to apply this sunscreen to your body. Just shake it up and spray it on your face, arms, legs, chest and anywhere else the sun kisses your body. I would recommend this to anyone who wants a delicious smelling SPF 50 Sunscreen that is easy to apply, doubles as a setting spray for makeup and adds a nice little glitter to your skin too. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This sunscreen is lightweight and doesn't feel sticky or heavy on my skin, which is really important to me, especially when I'm reapplying throughout the day. The spray is very fine, so it goes on evenly. I love that. It's an SPF 50. It doesn't have any white cast. it also does not leave a greasy residue. It does not transfer to my clothes.The glow it gives is absolutely beautiful. It has a subtle golden shimmer that makes my skin look luminous and healthy without looking overly glittery or too much. I also have pretty sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me or cause any breakouts.I love how hydrated and smooth my skin looks after using it. The packaging is perfect for on-the-go touch-ups, and I always keep it in my purse so I can reapply SPF easily. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am really loving this Golden Glow Shimmer Mist Setting Spray SPF50. I love the sun protecting properties and it protects my skin from the harmful UV and sun rays. I loke how gentle this mist feels, as well as the formula. As someone who has dry sensitive skin, I was impressed to see no irritations from this product. In fact, it felt refreshing and felt hydrating. My skin looks so healthy with a beautiful glow. The shimmer pigments are soft and melt nicely into the skin revealing a nice natural glow almost like glass skin. I can't wait to use this product over the Summer and it will be one of my go to for vacation. I received this product complimentary in exchange of my honest review . *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
